reviews.author: Chanda Clough
reviews.text: Pete & Ashley at the Northland office were amazing to work with from start to finish. They were super quick, no hassle, great follow-up, and they were able to get us the best rates possible. I would highly recommend their services - you will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Richard Heap
reviews.text: Ashley and this team are fabulous to work with in every way. Competent. Friendly. Effedtive. Patient. Quality products and above best-in-class service, period. I have had insurance products for 30 years. They are unmatched.

reviews.author: Craig Eddins
reviews.text: Excellent experience with the Ballentine Agency!! Peter contacted me prior to renewal and was able to provide even greater savings. I was Very impressed and appreciative!! For ME, they continue to have the best rates/coverage. They deserve Your consideration!! Thx Bret/Peter !!

reviews.author: Maya Greer
reviews.text: I have been with Farmer’s Insurance for over 10 years and Pete has been an absolute pleasure to work with. Pete exemplifies truly what customer service should be. No mater the time or issue, Pete ALWAYS responds quickly with accurate information. I truly appreciate his professionalism.

reviews.author: Trent Austin
reviews.text: Absolutely impeccably perfect service! This has been by far the best experience I’ve ever had with insurance agents. They truly care about you and go the extra mile to make everything right! The absolute best of the best! A+++++++++
reviews.ownerResponse: Wow—thank you so much, Trent! We’re thrilled to hear your experience with our team has been such a positive one. Providing caring, attentive service and going the extra mile for our clients is exactly what we strive for every day. We’re grateful for your trust in us for your business and insurance needs!

reviews.author: Dr. Sam Chuba
reviews.text: I’ve been with this insurance company for a while now, and I can confidently say they are head and shoulders above the rest! They’ve got me covered with all 4 of my vehicles, and their customer service is simply top-notch. Pete and Dillon are the best.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you so much, Sammy! We truly appreciate your kind words and the trust you place in our team. Pete and Dillon will be thrilled to hear your feedback — they take a lot of pride in providing the level of service you described. We’re so glad to have you with us!

reviews.author: Natalie VanLerberg
reviews.text: Pete-the office manager was extremely helpful and quick in an important situation for me. I will continue to use his office for all our insurance needs.

reviews.author: Jane Sommers
reviews.text: Pete Carroll has always taken great care of our families auto/home insurance needs. He has always gone above and beyond to get us the best rates possible. He’s honest, knowledgeable and always such a pleasure to deal with.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you, Jane! We really appreciate your loyalty and kind words. Pete truly cares about his customers and takes pride in finding the best coverage and value possible. We’re grateful to have him on our team — and to have your family with us! — Bret Ballentine & The BIG Team

reviews.author: Nicholas Lee
reviews.text: Ashley was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable. She listened to all of my concerns to find me options that best suit my needs. She did all of the work for me and got the information to me promptly. I highly recommend Bret Ballentine’s team for all your insurance needs.

reviews.author: Marsha Ross
reviews.text: Brett is AMAZING! He took an incredible amount of time, listening, and evaluating my business, and the issues I was having with my current Ins provider. I look forward to many years of doing great business together. So very pleased to have him as part of MY BUSINESS TEAM! *MGRoss - Window Treatments and More, Inc.
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you so much for the kind words, Marsha! We’re thrilled to be part of your business team and to help protect the company you’ve worked so hard to build. At BIG, we take pride in listening first and tailoring coverage to fit each client’s unique needs. We look forward to many successful years of partnership with Window Treatments and More!

reviews.author: Nita Pridgen
reviews.text: Saved us a bunch of money with his expertise

reviews.author: Sean Gillispie
reviews.text: These folks are the best in their business. No reason to look elsewhere!
